## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 06.08.2026 - 21.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Samanticss_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "The ONLY thing that kept me opening the app and checking off tasks every day was to try and get the month’s micropet. Now it’s behind a $40-120 paywall… and the main feature of every screen is many lock graphics🔒. I used to be a paid user but fell on hard times. I guess that means I deserve progressively worse service from a self care app I’ve used almost every day for three years. Squeezing from both ends with all these corporate sponsors too… and I heard you’re not good to your designers. Sell out."
            2. _mysticalgamer666_, 06.08.2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 14.08.2026 - 14.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Sarafrdyy_, 14.08.2026, 5/5: "This app is so incredible. There are no bugging ads or restrictions that basically forced you to buy the plus version of the app. It’s such a cute way to keep me focused on consistency in my habits, and I highly recommend it for anyone who has ADHD or autism. I hope the creator of Finch never deletes this app."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 28.05.2026 - 18.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28.05.2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _BaselineMI_, 18.08.2026, 5/5: "Hello, I’m having issues competing the “Pet Pickle” quest. I pet him all over the place and the quest doesn’t complete. Wonderful app that earns its five stars."
            3. _epicinsomniac_, 13.08.2026, 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
<!--/ir-theme-->
